page.layout: One column of centred lines, with a decorative border at the top. Name lines and a closing italic dedication, all set in the centre of the page. No margins, running head, page number or catchword.

page.notes: The top border is a printer's ornament and is not transcribed. Long s is written as plain s throughout (printed as s/f ligatures, e.g. "gravisfimis", "Clariss."). Lines with a printed bracket joining two lines (after ZIEGLERO, Quæstori; HUBERO; PEIERO; Adsessori) are shown with the second line's text as printed. "im Thurn" appears in black letter. The dedication lines in italic are set as one paragraph. No doubtful readings.
